subject: Request: Novaforge accelerator credit extension and conditional top-up
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@novaforge.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 19:13:00 -0800
Subject: Request: accelerator credit extension

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call last week. We're excited to get the Novaforge cohort integrated with Redwood for our demo runway. Two quick asks from my side:

1) Our accelerator start was delayed by a week due to legal reviews. Could we request a 30-day extension on the trial credits you allocated to Novaforge?
2) Given our planned spike during the final demo week (roughly 10k tokens/day for 3 days), would Redwood consider a short-term top-up we can consume against the same trial account?

I've attached our revised onboarding timeline and a high-level milestone plan. Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through it.

Best,
Amy Chen
Founder & CEO
Novaforge Labs

Attachments: novaforge_onboarding_timeline.pdf (pdf), pilot-milestones.xlsx (xls)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@novaforge.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credit extension

Hi Amy —

Really appreciate the heads up and the timeline. Short answer: we can usually accommodate an extension + small top-up for accelerator cohorts, provided we tie it to milestone commitments so the program stays fair for other participants.

Proposed next steps:
- We (Redwood) provide a 30-day extension on the existing trial window.
- One-time promotional top-up: $2,000 worth of credits (approx ~100k tokens depending on model) conditioned on Novaforge sharing the final demo recordings and a short post-mortem (1 page) within 14 days after demo week.

CC'ing Marissa (program ops) and Karthik (partnerships) to confirm operational fit and any partner promo constraints. Marcus from finance will need to sign off on the accounting treatment — looping him in.

If that sounds OK, I'll draft the simple amendment and push a DocuSign.

Thanks —
Tessa
Director, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Amy Chen <amy@novaforge.co>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credit extension

Hi Amy — welcome! This approach aligns with how we've handled similar cohort exceptions.
Quick operational notes:
- We'll tag the extension to Novaforge's program code so usage is visible in the Console.
- Please send the demo week dates so we can schedule the burst capacity reservation (helps avoid throttling).

Amy — can you confirm the demo week target dates and the expected approximate peak QPS? Even a rough number helps us provision.

Cheers,
Marissa
Program Lead, Startup Engagement

From: Amy Chen <amy@novaforge.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credit extension

Thanks Tessa and Marissa — that sounds fair. Demo week is the week of Dec 13–17; peak will be Dec 15–17. Expect ~8–12 requests/sec from our staging cluster at peak, roughly averaging 10k tokens/day total across the three days.

We'll commit to the post-demo writeup and to share a short clip from the final demo for Redwood's program content. Please send the amendment and I'll get that signed.

— Amy

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Amy Chen <amy@novaforge.co>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credit extension

Hi all —

Finance thumbs-up in principle. A couple of clarifying items before I formally approve the promo top-up:
- Accounting: we'll record the $2,000 as marketing/promotional expense tied to the Startup Program budget.
- Usage cap: we'll apply a hard cap to the promo credit to prevent overage surprises; any consumption beyond the cap would be charged at standard trial rates.
- Please confirm billing contact for the account so we can update invoicing metadata (company legal name + billing email).

If Amy confirms billing contact and agrees to the usage cap, I'll route the DocuSign approval for signature.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Amy Chen <amy@novaforge.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credit extension

Hi Marcus — billing contact is:
Novaforge Labs, Inc.
Attn: Operations Billing
billing@novaforge.co
EIN: 12-3456789

We accept the hard cap on the promo credit. Thanks for confirming the accounting treatment. Please send the DocuSign and I'll sign today.

Best,
Amy
